mapper.sql: SELECT v.id, v.frame_sn, v.model_id, m.model_name, v.status, CASE v.status WHEN 0 THEN '待组装' WHEN 1 THEN '组装完成' WHEN 2 THEN '已入库' WHEN 3 THEN '已出库' WHEN 4 THEN '返工中' WHEN 5 THEN '售后维修' WHEN 6 THEN '报废' ELSE '未知' END status_name, v.vehicle_qr_code, v.vehicle_qr_token, v.qr_generated_at, v.qr_version, v.assemble_operator_id, u.display_name assemble_operator_name, v.assemble_time, v.current_warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, v.current_location_id, l.location_name, v.stock_in_time, v.stock_out_time, v.current_customer_id, c.customer_name, v.current_order_no, MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'MOTOR' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END) motor_sn, MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'BATTERY' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END) battery_sn, MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'DISPLAY' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END) display_sn, v.created_at, v.updated_at, pv.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.product_name, pv.batch_no FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id = v.assemble_operator_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id = v.current_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id = v.current_location_id LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = v.current_customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle_part_binding b ON b.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=v.id LEFT JOIN bike_production_sku sku ON sku.id=pv.sku_id

where.if: AND (v.current_customer_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_user_customer_scope cs WHERE cs.user_id=#{customerScopeUser} AND cs.customer_id=v.current_customer_id))

AND (v.frame_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.vehicle_qr_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.current_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding bx WHERE bx.vehicle_id = v.id AND bx.part_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_customer cx WHERE cx.id = v.current_customer_id AND cx.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))

mapper.select: GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY v.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
WHERE v.frame_sn = #{frameSn} GROUP BY v.id FOR UPDATE
WHERE v.vehicle_qr_code = #{qrCode} OR v.vehicle_qr_token = #{qrCode} GROUP BY v.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_vehicle(frame_sn, model_id, status, qr_status) VALUES(#{frameSn}, #{modelId}, 0, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model WHERE id=#{modelId} AND enabled=1
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_vehicle SET vehicle_qr_code = #{qrCode}, vehicle_qr_token = #{token}, qr_generated_at = NOW(3), qr_version = #{version}, qr_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE bike_vehicle SET status = 1, assemble_operator_id = #{operatorId}, assemble_time = NOW(3), vehicle_qr_code = #{qrCode}, vehicle_qr_token = #{token}, qr_generated_at = NOW(3), qr_version = #{version}, qr_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
